<reason>B won a close debate by keeping the cleaner comparison: dating apps uniquely broker private meetings, status-quo bans are disposable, and even imperfect verification raises volume-fraud costs. A landed the sharpest attack—stolen IDs and rented faces yield false leads, plus lockout and moral hazard—and rightly pressed extras not in the motion, but never fully neutralized sticky bans or the conceded price increase. B’s “you named none” jab and clipped close kept the margin modest.</reason>
